result.edit: Replaced the sum assignment `assign s=(a|b|ci);` with the correct XOR-based full-adder sum `assign s=(a^b^ci);`. The OR expression produced 1 whenever any input was high (e.g., 11 at cycle3), whereas the expected sum is 0 for an odd number of high inputs (10), matching the observed value mismatch. Carry logic is unchanged.
